capabilities: Scroll a Markdown note automatically forward or reverse with pause and resume
Adjust speed, text size, line spacing, and horizontal or vertical mirroring
Accept input from on-screen controls, keyboard keys, and Bluetooth pedals including iOS touch page-turners
Refresh the teleprompter when the source note is edited without losing position or playback state
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states it was built with AI assistance and is fully local and read-only, with a pedal input inspector for troubleshooting Bluetooth pedals.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read a note as a scrolling teleprompter for scripts or presentations, especially on phones and tablets.
summary: Teleprompter that scrolls any Markdown note at adjustable speed with pause/resume, mirroring, and pedal, keyboard, or on-screen controls on mobile and desktop.
